mapper.sql: ics20_revision_history_id AS revision_history_id, ics20_reg_date AS reg_date, ics20_submission_date AS submission_date, ics20_effect_date AS effect_date, ics20_reflection_date AS reflection_date, ics20_finance_agency_cd AS finance_agency_code, f_cdnm('FinanceAgencyCode', ics20_finance_agency_cd, 0, ics20_reg_date) AS finance_agency_name, ics20_title AS title, ics20_related_law AS related_law, ics20_note AS note, ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ics19_revision_relate_ics WHERE ics19_revision_history_id = ics20_revision_history_id ) AS ics_count, ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys10_file WHERE sys10_parent_id = ics20_revision_history_id ) AS file_count
mapper.select:
SELECT FROM ics20_revision_history WHERE COALESCE(ics20_finance_agency_cd, '') LIKE #{financeAgencyCode}
AND ics20_reg_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND COALESCE(#{closeDate}, to_date('29991231','yyyyMMdd'))
AND ics20_effect_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND COALESCE(#{closeDate}, to_date('29991231','yyyyMMdd'))
AND UPPER(CONCAT(f_cdnm('FinanceAgencyCode', ics20_finance_agency_cd, 0, ics20_reg_date), ics20_title, ics20_note)) LIKE UPPER(#{searchText}) AND UPPER(COALESCE(ics20_related_law, '')) LIKE UPPER(#{relatedLawSearchText})
ORDER BY ics20_reg_date DESC, ics20_finance_agency_cd, ics20_title, ics20_note
ORDER BY ics20_effect_date DESC, ics20_finance_agency_cd, ics20_title, ics20_note
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ics20_revision_history ( ics20_revision_history_id, ics20_reg_date, ics20_submission_date, ics20_effect_date, ics20_reflection_date, ics20_finance_agency_cd, ics20_title, ics20_related_law, ics20_note ) VALUES ( #{revisionHistoryId}, #{req.regDate}, #{req.submissionDate}, #{req.effectDate}, #{req.reflectionDate}, #{req.financeAgencyCode}, #{req.title}, #{req.relatedLaw}, #{req.note} )
mapper.update: UPDATE ics20_revision_history SET ics20_reg_date = #{req.regDate}, ics20_submission_date = #{req.submissionDate}, ics20_effect_date = #{req.effectDate}, ics20_reflection_date = #{req.reflectionDate}, ics20_finance_agency_cd = #{req.financeAgencyCode}, ics20_title = #{req.title}, ics20_related_law = #{req.relatedLaw}, ics20_note = #{req.note} WHERE ics20_revision_history_id = #{revisionHistoryId}
mapper.sql: ics19_revision_relate_ics_id AS revision_relate_ics_id, ics19_revision_history_id AS revision_history_id, ics19_class_tree_id AS class_tree_id, ics01_class_tree_nm AS class_tree_name
mapper.select: SELECT FROM ics19_revision_relate_ics INNER JOIN ics01_class_tree ON ics01_class_tree_id = ics19_class_tree_id WHERE ics19_revision_history_id = #{revisionHistoryId}
SELECT FROM ics19_revision_relate_ics INNER JOIN ics01_class_tree ON ics01_class_tree_id = ics19_class_tree_id WHERE ics19_revision_relate_ics_id = #{revisionRelateIcsId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ics19_revision_relate_ics ( ics19_revision_relate_ics_id, ics19_revision_history_id, ics19_class_tree_id ) VALUES ( #{revisionRelateIcsId}, #{revisionHistoryId}, #{classTreeId} )
